text: Aflac Incorporated's 2026 proxy statement lists the holders of more than 5% of its common stock as of 24 February 2026: The Vanguard Group (11.1% of the shares, 4.4% of the votes), J&A Alliance Holdings Corporation as trustee of J&A Alliance Trust (10.2% of the shares, 20.0% of the votes) and BlackRock, Inc. (8.2% of the shares, 3.3% of the votes). Japan Post Holdings is the trust's sole settlor and beneficiary; the shareholders agreement limits the trustee's voting rights to no more than 20%, and the proxy says Japan Post Holdings will have no board seat and no rights to control, manage or intervene in the management of the company.
short: Aflac Incorporated's 5% holders are Vanguard (11.1%), a trust for Japan Post Holdings (10.2%, no board seat) and BlackRock (8.2%).

source.name: Aflac Incorporated: 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: Japan Post Holdings will not have a Board seat on the Company's Board of Directors and will not have rights to control, manage or intervene in the management of the Company
